set.body:
Source: review findings in AgentDomainJson.scala LogPage codecs and AgentService/SshAgentApi negotiation.

Problem:
derived Vector[Byte] JSON expands bytes into number arrays, so a legal raw log page can exceed the negotiated frame limit. Frame negotiation is not authoritative for both inbound and outbound payloads, and handshake ordering is not a durable session invariant.

Acceptance:
- Encode log bytes compactly with an explicitly owned cross-language representation such as base64 ByteVector.
- Budget response envelopes so every accepted max-page request fits the negotiated frame limit, including JSON/framing overhead.
- Make negotiated limits authoritative end to end, or replace decorative negotiation with a truthful stateless contract.
- Enforce the chosen handshake/session ordering and test boundary-size pages, 0x80-0xff bytes, oversized requests, and cross-language fixtures.
set.title: P6f.4: Make agent log bytes and frame negotiation honest
